body.name: Zero-allowed latent feedback class and law set
body.construction: \(\mathfrak M_{\mathcal I}^{\leq}(G)\) is the set of pairs \((B,(P_{\varepsilon_i})_{i\in V})\) such that \(\operatorname{supp}(B)\subseteq E(G)\), \(\det(Q_{V\setminus S,V\setminus S})\ne0\) for every \(S\in\mathcal I\), the source coordinates are mutually independent, nonconstant, and non-Gaussian, and interventions are surgical.
